facts.fact: Jasper's Pro plan is listed at $69 per seat per month on the pricing page.
facts.quote: Pro $ 69 month/ seat Powerful AI to help you stay on-brand, even at scale.

facts.fact: A second Pro plan block on the same pricing page lists $59 per seat per month; the page text does not state what distinguishes the two listings.
facts.quote: ### Pro $ 59 month/ seat Powerful AI to help you stay on-brand, even at scale.

facts.fact: The Pro plan includes 2 Brand Voices, 5 Knowledge assets and 3 Audiences.
facts.quote: Smart customization with 2 Brand Voices, 5 Knowledge assets and 3 Audiences

facts.fact: The Business plan provides unlimited Brand Voices, Knowledge and Audiences customization.
facts.quote: Unlimited IQ customization: Brand Voices, Knowledge, Audiences

facts.fact: The Business plan includes API access, while the Pro plan's listed features do not include it.
Jasper states that its content can be created or repurposed in over 30 languages.
facts.quote: 30+ Languages Easily create or repurpose content in over 30 languages.

facts.fact: Jasper states it offers over 100 purpose-built marketing agents.
Jasper's Audiences feature is limited to 3 audiences on Pro and unlimited on the higher tier.
Jasper's Brand Voice feature is limited to 2 voices on Pro and unlimited on the higher tier.
Jasper's multi-modal company knowledge is limited to 5 assets on Pro and unlimited on the higher tier.
facts.quote: 5 multi-modal knowledge assets Unlimited multi-modal knowledge assets

facts.fact: The Business plan includes dedicated account management and priority support.
